questionText: Which one of the following is used to represent the supporting many-one relationships of a weak entity set in an entity-relationship diagram?
explanation:
In Entity-Relationship (ER) Diagrams:

• Identifying / Supporting Relationship: Represented by diamonds with double/bold border.
• Weak Entity Set: Represented by rectangles with double/bold border.
• Multivalued Attribute: Represented by ovals with double/bold border.
• Primary Key Attribute: Represented by ovals containing underlined text.

Thus, the supporting relationship of a weak entity set is represented by diamonds with a double/bold border.
